name: hablo
description: Hear Claude Code's replies aloud in your language: a Listen button under each reply and /hablo. Free and offline on macOS.

rate.title: Speaking rate
rate.description: Words per minute. 0 keeps the system default.

voices.title: Voices
voices.description: Voice per language, e.g. es=Paulina, en=Samantha. Empty picks one automatically.

autoRead.title: Read every reply
autoRead.description: Read each reply aloud as soon as Claude finishes.
